newsitem.title: USA: AutoInfo boosts revolving credit line.
newsitem.headline: AutoInfo boosts revolving credit line.

text.p: AutoInfo Inc said it has entered into a $100 million revolving credit facility which replaces a $42 million dollar credit line from FINOVA Group Inc.

AutoInfo said the new facility from CS First Boston has a three year term and provides for an improved advance rate and cost of funds over the company's current facility. The proceeds of the facility will be used to repay the outstanding balance of about $15 million under the current credit facility and to facilitate the expansion of the company's portfolio of non-prime automobile loans.

"Our new credit facility is another major building block in AutoInfo's strategy of becoming a significant player in the non-prime automobile market," stated chief executive Scott Zecher. "The addition of this $100 million facility and the reduced cost of funds from our prior facility will contribute significantly to the achievement of our strategic growth plan," added Zecher.

"We are extremely pleased to align with our new investment bankers, given their recognized leadership position in both the financing and securitization of automobile loan portfolios." -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
